nodes.label: Quota Manager
nodes.rationale: Probes provider quotas via the external codexbar CLI, parsing provider-specific formats (credits, balance, usage percentages). Uses a 60-second cache TTL and gracefully falls back to stale data on probe failure, assuming availability on parse errors to avoid false negatives.

nodes.label: Codexbar CLI Quota Probe
nodes.rationale: External CLI tool (codexbar usage --format json --provider all) spawned via Bun.spawn to retrieve live quota data. Must be installed separately; quota manager gracefully degrades on probe failure.
